import json, subprocess, sys
base = open('/app/examples/input.json').read()
# exactly 16 MiB with leading/trailing whitespace
pad = 16 * 1024 * 1024 - len(base.encode()) - 1
doc = " " * (pad // 2) + base + "\n" + " " * (pad - pad // 2)
assert len(doc.encode()) == 16 * 1024 * 1024, len(doc.encode())
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=doc.encode(), capture_output=True)
print("exactly 16MiB ->", p.stdout[:40], "len", len(p.stdout))
# 16 MiB + 1
doc2 = doc + " "
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=doc2.encode(), capture_output=True)
print("16MiB+1    ->", p.stdout[:40])
# 20 MiB of packets
big = json.dumps({"version": 1, "config": json.load(open('/app/examples/input.json'))["config"],
                  "model": json.load(open('/app/examples/input.json'))["model"],
                  "connections": [], "packets": []})
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=(big + " " * (17 * 1024 * 1024)).encode(), capture_output=True)
print("17MiB ws   ->", p.stdout[:40])
